applies_why: This judge text decides whether cited verses count as unanswered witnesses and whether a broken link remains uncured under K-G4.
quote: RESULT: UNCURED; WHY: no PRESSED line, no RETRACTED line, and no statement that names a pressing round and quotes it, for D2 vs C3; malformed line: RETRACTED: D2 vs C3 -- the challenger's own later rounds quoted and answered the witnesses
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
room: The phrase 'If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it': I weighed reading it to require accepting an answered-witness retraction despite a malformed RETRACTED line, versus reading it to allow rejecting such a retraction as uncured and effectively counting the answered witnesses.
why: The judge text acknowledges the witnesses were quoted and answered but still marks the retraction malformed and the result UNCURED, so it does not treat the answered verses as excluded from the broken-link count.
